sections.disclaimer_html: Chime Health offers compounded GLP-1s exclusively from U.S. pharmacies. Compounded medications are regulated and compounding pharmacies are licensed and inspected by Boards of Pharmacy, but the FDA has not evaluated the medications for safety, quality, or efficacy. GLP-1 medications are prescription drugs that should be taken and monitored under the supervision of a licensed health care professional. GLP-1 medications carry serious risks, including risks of thyroid C-cell tumors (which includes thyroid cancer) and medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC). Talk to your clinician if you get a lump or swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath.

sections.title: Wondering About Side Effects, Safety, or Results?
sections.text: Prescription weight loss can feel overwhelming. We've answered the most common questions here so you can move forward with confidence. Our clinicians & care team are always a message or call away.

items.q: What happens if I don't see results?
items.a: Chime offers a weight loss guarantee. If you follow your treatment plan and do not see qualifying results, contact the care team so they can review your progress and next steps.
Your plan includes clinician review, a personalized prescription if approved, medication shipped to your door, free delivery, and ongoing access to support.
Chime offers GLP-1 treatment plans, including compounded semaglutide and compounded tirzepatide when clinically appropriate.
Start with the online assessment. A licensed clinician reviews your information, creates a plan if you qualify, and your medication is shipped directly to you.
Chime serves eligible members in supported U.S. states. Availability can depend on local telehealth and pharmacy rules.

items.q: What can I expect after I sign up?
items.a: After sign-up, your intake is reviewed, you receive next-step instructions, and, if approved, your treatment is prepared and shipped with tracking.
No. Chime plans do not require insurance, and pricing is shown before checkout.

items.q: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
items.a: Plans are month to month. You can manage cancellation through support according to the plan terms and timing of your order.

items.q: I have a previous prescription from another weight-loss company, can I start at a higher dosage?
items.a: A clinician will review your current or previous prescription and medical history before deciding whether a higher starting dose is appropriate.

items.q: How do I know I'll get support if something goes wrong?
items.a: Members can contact the care team for treatment, shipping, refill, and account questions throughout the program.

items.q: This feels expensive. What makes Chime worth it?
items.a: The plan combines clinician oversight, medication if prescribed, support, and direct-to-door delivery in one program.

items.q: Is Chime as legitimate as seeing a local clinician?
items.a: Chime uses licensed clinicians and U.S. pharmacy partners to provide online care where telehealth is available.

items.q: How fast will I see results?
items.a: Results vary by person, but many members report progress within the first few months when following their treatment plan.

items.q: I'm nervous about injections. What should I expect?
items.a: The care team provides guidance for using your medication. If injections make you nervous, ask support for step-by-step help before your first dose.
